name: Insignia (Best Buy house brand)
summary: Best Buy's long-running house electronics brand, extended into 3D-printing filament in 2026: PLA, Matte PLA, PETG and TPU 95A on ~155 g cardboard spools at aggressive retail pricing ($11-20/kg), sold only through bestbuy.com and Best Buy stores. Published specs are unusually complete for a house brand (temps, speeds, tolerance), but the contract extruder is undisclosed.

oem_relationships.notes: Insignia is Best Buy's house brand (Richfield, MN).

No OEM disclosure on product pages or secondary coverage. A Bambu Lab forum thread documents the cardboard spool (~155 g) but shows Sunlu only as a user's separate respool reel — not evidence of a Sunlu supply relationship.

product_lines.name: Insignia PLA
product_lines.notes: NS-3FSPLA2* SKUs; 1.75 mm +/-0.02, 1 kg, 190-230 C / 25-60 C bed, up to 350 mm/s; 11 colors; $12.99.

product_lines.name: Insignia Matte PLA
product_lines.notes: NS-3FMPLA2* SKUs; 190-230 C / 25-60 C, up to 300 mm/s; 5 colors incl. Matte Pastel Rainbow; $10.99.

product_lines.name: Insignia PETG
product_lines.notes: NS-3FPETG2* SKUs; 240-260 C / 60-70 C bed, up to 300 mm/s; 5 colors; $11.99.

additional_notes: Retail-only house brand; no brand site or TDS beyond Best Buy product-page specs. Entered the catalog 2026-09-20 on owner report.

provenance.conflicts: Spool weight ~155 g appears in listing/forum coverage but is approximate; contract extruder unknown.
